members.name: instanceData
members.description: The data containing the transforms and colors information for the instances. This is a mat3x4 split into 3 attributes and an extra vec4 buffer for color/custom data.

members.name: instanceCount
members.description: The number of instances that will be rendered, applied per mesh. Increasing this value above the previous limit will rebuild instanceData.

members.name: updateMode
members.description: How instance updates are uploaded to the GPU (ONE_BY_ONE, ALL or CHUNK). ONE_BY_ONE can cause increased API calls with many updating instances; ALL uploads everything at once; CHUNK uploads the updated region only.

functions.name: new
functions.description: Creates a new FoxInstancedModel, like FoxModel but designed to render a mesh multiple times, useful for particles or special effects.

functions.name: setInstanceTransform
functions.description: Changes an instance's position, rotation and scale from a matrix. Note: this will not include the last column of the matrix.

functions.name: setInstanceTransformSeparate
functions.description: Transforms an instance from a set of components.

functions.name: getInstanceTransform
functions.description: Extracts a Matrix3D containing the instance transform data. To get position, rotation and scale, use the matrix's decompose().

functions.name: setInstanceColor
functions.description: Changes the color of an instance in RGBA float. Gets multiplied by vertex colors and a material's color parameter.

functions.name: setInstanceFlxColor
functions.description: Changes the color of an instance using a FlxColor.

functions.name: getInstanceColor
functions.description: Gets the RGBA float color of an instance.

functions.name: getInstanceFlxColor
functions.description: Gets the color of an instance as a FlxColor.

functions.name: pushUpdate
functions.description: Marks an instance as needing a GPU buffer update, according to updateMode.
